text:
riley (People Ops): hey @nora.rehire welcome back! quick checklist for your rehire start next Mon:
- I-9: since you're returning from a contractor stint and your SSN card is delayed, we can do Section 1 now and Section 2 within 3 days. options: office kiosk, local agent, or our courier-assisted verification.

nora.rehire: thanks. my SSN card was lost in mail, replacement processing taking longer. can payroll start without it? also vendor asked for fingerprints again.

riley (People Ops): payroll can provision a provisional record so you get paid; final IRS matching after SSN arrives. please upload any SSN application receipt if you have it. about fingerprints, sometimes the vendor requests them for previous county jurisdictions; we can book a local partner. which city are you in?

nora.rehire: Seattle. also my last name changed since I left, will that cause trouble for I-9?

ben (Benefits): name changes are fine but we need supporting docs (marriage cert or court order) plus a signed Name Affidavit. You can still elect benefits Day 1; enrollments can be corrected once docs arrive.

nora.rehire: uploaded marriage cert and SSN application receipt to portal.

vericheck-bot: VeriCheck: background check portal sent to nora.rehire@example.com. Action: upload any local fingerprint results or reply BOOK_FINGERPRINT and we will schedule a partner appointment.

nora.rehire: BOOK_FINGERPRINT please, morning slot preferred.

it-ops-bot: Laptop shipping: package PKG-9912 shows ETA 2 days. If SSN delay affects desk assignment, we can hold delivery at HQ or send to your home. Reply HOLD_AT_HQ or DELIVER_HOME.

sasha (Onboarding Buddy): hi @nora.rehire i'll set a 30-min Day 1 sync at 10:00 PT to run through benefits, security, and team intros. if laptop delayed we'll use a loaner.

nora.rehire: HOLD_AT_HQ please. thanks everyone, excited to be back!
